asn.description: Autonomous System Number to analyze (1-4294967295). Examples: 15169 (Google), 7922 (Comcast), 13335 (Cloudflare), 32934 (Facebook). Returns organization details, network size metrics (customer cone, prefixes, ASN relationships), geographic presence, hegemony scores, and connectivity patterns - crucial for competitive intelligence, peering analysis, and Internet topology research. Omit to browse or filter all ASNs.

country.description: Filter ASNs by country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g., 'US', 'DE', 'JP'). Useful for finding all autonomous systems registered in a specific country.

page.description: Page number for paginated results when browsing all ASNs or filtering by country/search. Starts from 0.

page_size.description: Number of results per page (max 10000). Default: 100. Use for pagination when browsing large result sets.

search.description: Search ASNs by name or organization (case-insensitive partial match). Examples: 'google', 'comcast', 'cloudflare'. Useful for finding ASNs when you don't know the exact number.
